labels.name: Stratum corneum
labels.function: Barrier layer formed with filaggrin; its thickening is hyperkeratosis

labels.name: Epidermis
labels.function: Thickening of this whole layer is acanthosis

labels.name: Spongiosis
labels.function: Fluid between keratinocytes; histologic hallmark of dermatitis

labels.name: Perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate
labels.function: Superficial dermal change seen in early atopic lesions

labels.name: Eosinophil
labels.function: Activated by Th2 interleukins; infiltrates chronic atopic dermis

labels.name: Dermis
labels.function: Connective layer where chronic atopic inflammatory cells gather

labels.name: Sebaceous gland
labels.function: Sebum source that lets Malassezia thrive

labels.name: Follicular opening
labels.function: Neutrophils cluster here in seborrheic dermatitis

labels.name: Hapten
labels.function: Low-molecular-weight allergen; not immunogenic on its own

labels.name: Carrier protein
labels.function: Skin molecule whose binding makes the allergen visible

labels.name: Langerhans cell
labels.function: Engulfs the tagged complex and migrates to present it

labels.name: Lymph node
labels.function: Site where the allergen is shown to naive T cells

labels.name: Naive T cell
labels.function: Primed on first exposure into a hapten-specific clone

labels.name: Memory T cell
labels.function: Hapten-specific cell that responds on re-exposure

labels.name: Inflammatory mediators
labels.function: Released into skin to cause local inflammation after a delay
